info.title: Mailhub management API
info.description: Active single-owner management REST API. Bearer credentials can be static API keys or configured OAuth access tokens. x-required-permission records the exact scope; compliance also enforces configured domain/action grants. Errors are generally plain text. Legacy handlers may accept undocumented method aliases; use only the documented methods. JMAP is a separate contract.

bearerAuth.description: Static API key or configured OAuth access token. Mailbox passwords/Basic Auth are not management credentials.

username.description: Nonempty, at most 255 UTF-8 bytes; no whitespace/control characters.

password.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes. OpenAPI string lengths count characters; the server validates encoded bytes.

email.description: Defaults to username; must contain @ and satisfy identifier rules.

password.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes. OpenAPI string lengths count characters; the server validates encoded bytes. Empty string means unchanged.

email.description: Empty string means unchanged; otherwise must contain @ and satisfy identifier rules.

MailboxUpdate.description: Supply at least one change: a nonempty password/email or enabled. Empty strings do not change stored values.

data.description: Base64 message bytes; null in redacted compliance lists.

storage.description: Storage counters from the running backend.

Policy.description: Inline script required for saves. Starlark is the supported managed filter engine. PUT replaces the definition; URL supplies name. Nested scope keys serialize with Go field capitalization; decoder also accepts case-insensitive names.

Actions.description: Per-recipient Sieve execution plan. Null for non-Sieve policy actions.

Error.description: Plain-text failure. Inspect HTTP status before decoding. Authorization failures may be 401 or 403 depending on credential mode.
